title: Transition from Rewind to Run
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine and $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, and fix a Boolean loop parameter, a Boolean input word $x$, a natural number $m$, and a choice bit $b$. For any input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions and any contents and head positions for the work tapes of $S$ and $A$, if the yard tape stores a word of $m$ true symbols starting at cell $0$ and its head is at cell $-1$, one step of the host machine enters the run phase with $A$ in its initial state and no captured output. The input head moves one position right, the yard head moves to cell $0$, and the other tape contents, their head positions, and the output word remain unchanged.

the input-head position is one of the $|x|+2$ valid positions
